title: (nostalgia) — Temporal Offset Between Caption and Image
subtitle: Each caption describes the next archival photograph before it appears
theorem: Displace commentary one step ahead of the visible record so the viewer splits attention between anticipating the next image and remembering the description when that image finally arrives.
boundary_note: The +1 index offset (`Caption[n+1]` over `Image[n]`) is explicitly declared in the HUD so the mismatch is recognized as a temporal structure rather than a labeling error.

v1_defect_timecodes: Seg #06 (t=28.50s-34.50s): `aaf17c56` at 1.0s-7.0s showed hands over a type-case rather than a flame/smoke in darkness.
critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Replaced Seg #06 with verified fire/smoke flare in darkness (`b45f3dbf`, `Watershed wildfire`, `0.2s-6.2s`) so the described flame and smoke visibly arrive while Image [06] remains withheld.
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: Every segment explicitly pairs `IMAGE [k]` with `VOICE/TEXT [k+1]` across `b51dad21`, `b066405d`, `8b47cb5b`, `df8ac203`, and `b45f3dbf`.
